newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swap - Regrade narrows as jet slips.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swap - Regrade narrows as jet slips.

text.p: Singapore front month August jet fuel/gas oil spread or regrade narrowed at midday on Tuesday as the prompt physical jet fuel is poised to come off further on sustained selling pressure, traders said.
"The regrade is really coming in now after the jet fuel was offered down agressively in the physical market," one trader said.
August regrade was last quoted at 40/60 cents per barrel, unchanged from late Monday prices, but down sharply from Friday's $0.85/$1.00, brokers said.
Outright August jet fuel swaps traded late Monday at $23.10 when August gas oil traded at $22.70, giving a regrade value of 40 cents, brokers said.
Traders said the fall in the regrade value was triggered by the absence of a Singapore trader from the local spot market late last week.
The local trader has over the past two weeks bought several jet fuel cargoes--giving the market a much needed boost at a time when regional demand was at a low.
Jet fuel traded on Tuesday at $23.40 per barrel but offers at $23.00 on Monday failed to draw out any buying interest.
Traders the front month regrade will be in steep contango due to the perceived prompt weakness. September regrade was last quoted at $0.80/$1.00.
Gas oil swaps were steady in quiet morning trading in the absence of fresh indicators.
August gas oil swaps were last quoted unchanged from Monday at $22.60/$22.75.
Fuel oil was also quoted steady with August seen at $99.00/$99.75 per tonne.
